description: Dreamwalker Girdle Level 60 Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Dreamwalker Girdle if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Girdle, 8 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 3 Mooncloth and 2 Cured Rugged Hides. Requirements: - Desecrated Girdle - Wartorn Leather Scrap x 8 - Mooncloth x 3 - Cured Rugged Hide x 2
name: Dreamwalker Girdle
